items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I can't understand Hannah Mandilakova. There's something wrong with her concentration. She needs a coach, she needs a mentor.

ctx.x: You know who I'm talking about. The third one, the little one, the young one... Not one of them has a serve. They just throw the ball way up in the air and wait for it to come down, and they serve. That's the reason why Navratilova pounces on that serve and beats the shit out of them. That's the reason why I can't understand Hannah Mandilakova. There's something wrong with her concentration. She needs a coach, she needs a mentor. Either that, or she needs to get laid. Or something. I don't know what the hell it…
Now, there's a few coming up! I've seen a couple, Horvath and a few of those, you know. I follow that game, you know...
